correctness.rationale: For the exact globally Lipschitz vector field, two explicitly verified branch identities yield the mean-square equality and a sign-weighted kinetic obstruction; a smooth regularization proves the switching-plane measure balance, and invariance plus Fubini removes level-set kinetic mass. These steps imply equilibrium-only measures for \(|A|>1\), convergence of bounded forward trajectories via monotone L and connected omega limit, and at each boundary a complete invariant-measure decomposition into isolated opposite equilibrium plus bounded complete harmonic circles confined to one halfspace. Periodic Wirtinger yields \(T\ge2\pi\), and exact equality substitution forces only the displayed \(A=\pm1\), \(r\le1\) circles. SymPy 1.14.0 verified both branch derivatives, critical characteristic factorizations, and circle substitution from included paths; the measure and period arguments are analytic, not computational extrapolations. At the critical values, L is monotone along bounded orbits; it is constant on omega-limits, evaluates to r^2-1/2 on each circle and to 1/2 at the opposite equilibrium, so its limiting level selects one radius. Connectedness excludes the only tie between the grazing circle and the isolated opposite equilibrium. Flow invariance then makes a nontrivial selected omega-limit the entire circle.

value.rationale: At the historically natural marginal-damping boundary of a canonical almost-linear chaotic flow, the theorem exhausts every compact stationary measure and, more strongly, selects the exact unique omega-limit periodic circle or equilibrium for each bounded forward orbit. The monotone coboundary level gives an explicit radius selector, and the radius-one grazing cutoff identifies the maximal critical invariant annulus. Outside the threshold, bounded-forward equilibrium convergence is complete, while a negative-damping critical family shows exceptional bounded motion despite volume expansion. The universal period floor is useful context already established in a broader jerk class, not a novelty claim. The critical omega-limit theorem is structural and mathematically motivated rather than an arbitrary invariant slice.
